title: SXT-011 normalized patch graph (one JSONL line)
description: One compact single-line JSON object per census entry in corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl. All state is NORMALIZED (post-migration) read from the pinned native engine via surgepy after SurgeSynthesizer::loadPatch at 48 kHz. Raw .fxp ids are never exported as state; they appear only in the raw_* fields of migration events. Deterministic: same corpus bytes + engine pin => byte-identical lines.

p.description: Census path, identical to corpus-manifest.json entries[].path (relative to the engine tree root).

b.description: Bank derived from the census path.

sha.description: Git blob SHA-1 of the .fxp, re-verified against the on-disk file at export time (mismatch aborts the run).

sz.description: File size in bytes, re-verified at export time.

st.description: Per-entry status. Every census entry has exactly one line, so every entry has a status.

why.description: {phase: load|extract|validate|migration_compare, reason: load_false|exception|schema_validation_failed, detail}. Present on analysis_failure lines only.

rev.description: Stored patch revision streamed from the raw XML <patch revision=...> attribute (SurgePatch.cpp load_xml). Absent when the raw XML is unreadable.

pin.description: {e: engine commit, sr: sample rate, sv: schema version}. Repeated per line so every line is independently verifiable.

g.description: The normalized graph. Present on normalized lines only.

sm.description: Scene mode id (surgepy.constants sm_single/sm_split/sm_dual/sm_chsplit; live param max 3).

smn.description: Engine display name of the scene mode (e.g. 'Single', 'Key Split').

spl.description: Split point MIDI note (meaningful for split modes).

poly.description: Polylimit (global). Loader default DEFAULT_POLYLIMIT=16 applies to files that do not store it.

fxb.description: fx_bypass id: 0=All FX, 1=No Send FX, 2=No Send and Global FX, 3=All FX Off (fxb_all_fx..fxb_no_fx, SurgeStorage.h). Bypass state of the FX section.

fxd.description: fx_disable bitmask; bit (1<<slot) disables fx slot 'slot' individually (SurgeSynthesizer.cpp process: 'fx_disable.val.i & (1 << v)').

vol.description: Global volume (dB scale of the engine param).

sc.description: Per-scene state, index 0=scene A, 1=scene B. Both scenes are exported regardless of scene mode; inactive scenes carry loader defaults.

fx.description: All 16 FX slots as exposed by the pinned engine (n_fx_slots=16).

md.description: Modulation routings: {g: global routes, s: [per-scene {s: scene-bus routes, v: voice-bus routes}]}.

wta.description: Wavetable asset records for oscillators whose normalized type is wavetable/window. Absent when the preset uses none.

dep.description: Dynamic dependency flags; 'audio_input' when any oscillator slot's normalized type is Audio Input (external signal dependency). Absent when empty.

mi.description: Loader migration events: raw stored id vs normalized value differences (see below). Absent when none observed.

rwm.description: raw_missing: migration-prone int fields absent from the raw XML (loader defaults applied). Absent when none.

rwu.description: raw_uninterpretable: raw values present but outside any plausible id range for the field (e.g. old float bit-pattern storage under an int tag). Recorded, never compared, never dropped. Absent when none.

raw_note.description: Present when the raw XML sidecar is unreadable (e.g. Percussion/Snare Tight.fxp): the normalized graph is complete and authoritative; the raw comparison is waived and the waiver is recorded here.

fbc.description: Filter block configuration id (fc_serial1..fc_wide) - the filter TOPOLOGY.

fbcn.description: Engine display name of the filter block configuration.

f2off.description: Filter 2 cutoff is offset from filter 1 (flag).

send.description: Scene send levels. The pinned engine exposes send_level[0..1] through surgepy; send buses 3/4 (slots S3/S4) exist in the engine but no factory .fxp stores levels for them and the binding does not expose them (documented gap; loader defaults apply).

mix.description: Mixer per path o1,o2,o3,ring_12,ring_23,noise: [level, mute, solo, route]. route: 0=Filter 1, 1=Both, 2=Filter 2 (engine display).

fm.description: {sw: FM routing id (fm_off..fm_2and3to1), dep: FM depth}.

ws.description: {t: waveshaper type id, tn: display name, dr: drive}. Waveshaper type ids exceed the surgepy.constants wst_* set (live max 42); names come from the engine.

lfo.description: LFO 1..6 (scene LFOs; SLFOs are LFO 7..12 in the engine UI naming and appear here only insofar as the engine exposes them per scene - the pinned engine stores 6 scene + 6 scene-B LFOs as lfo[0..5] of each scene).

t.description: Oscillator type id (ot_classic..ot_window constants cover 0..7; 8..11 are Modern/String/Twist/Alias; live param max 11).

tn.description: Engine display name of the type.

p.description: The 7 normalized oscillator params. p[0] is the SUBMODE selector for every family that has one (Classic 'Shape'/subtype, Sine 'Shape', wavetable 'Morph', ...). p[5]/p[6] are Unison Detune / Unison Voices for the families that have unison.

uni.description: Unison voice count (param whose engine name ends 'Unison Voices'). Absent for families without unison.

udet.description: Unison detune. Absent for families without unison.

wt.description: Present (true) when the normalized type is wavetable or window; a matching record exists in g.wta.

t.description: Filter type id (current sst-filters fut_ space; live param max 35).

tn.description: Engine display name of the filter type.

st.description: Filter subtype id (clamped by the loader to fut_subcount[type]-1 at stream time, SurgePatch.cpp).

stn.description: Engine display name of the subtype.

r.description: Slot role: a*=scene A insert chain, b*=scene B insert chain, send*=send buses, global*=global chain. ROUTING/placement is the role plus the fixed engine processing order: A1->A4 then B1->B4 on the scene outputs, scene sum, send buses S1..S4 mixed to the main output with per-slot return_level, then G1->G4 on the summed output (SurgeSynthesizer.cpp process).

t.description: Effect type id (fxt_off=0; live param max 31; surgepy.constants fxt_* covers a subset).

tn.description: Engine display name of the effect type.

on.description: 1 when the slot holds a non-Off effect; Off slots carry only i/r/t/tn/on.

p.description: The 12 normalized FX params. Param NAMES are engine-defined per effect type at runtime (not stored in this schema); recover any name via getPatch().fx[i].p[j].getName().

rl.description: Return level (send/return placement gain; modulation of return levels appears in g.md).

aw.description: Airwindows ONLY: exact algorithm id = p[0] (int).

awn.description: Airwindows ONLY: engine display name of that algorithm (e.g. 49 = 'Galactic').

row.description: [source_id, source_scene, source_index, dest_synthside_id, dest_name, depth, normalized_depth].

source_id.description: modsources enum id; validated against the live surgepy.constants ms_* set. Names: e.g. 7=ctrl1 (macro), 17=lfo1, 26=slfo4, 39=highest_key.

dest_synthside_id.description: RAW parameter id mapping: the synth-side id from SurgeSynthesizer::ID::getSynthSideId() of the destination Parameter as returned by getAllModRoutings(); for scene-bus routes the binding adds storage.getPatch().scene_start[sc] to the destination so the id is absolute across both scenes (surgepy.cpp getAllModRoutings). The name is recovered via getParameterName(id); it is stored in row[4] so consumers do not need the id map.

normalized_depth.description: getModDepth01()-normalized depth (surgepy binding computes it live).

buses.description: md.g: patch-level (global) routings incl. FX-parameter modulation; md.s[k].s: scene routings of scene k; md.s[k].v: voice routings of scene k.

name.description: Wavetable display name as streamed from the raw XML <extraoscdata wavetable_display_name=...> (SurgePatch.cpp load_xml). null when absent: the engine then displays '(Patch Wavetable)' or '(Patch Sample)' (SurgePatch.cpp). PROVENANCE: this is a raw-side string (names are not migrated numerics); the engine's resolved table is what sounds.

emb.description: Embedded wavetable byte size for this scene/osc from the .fxp chunk header (wtsize[scene][osc] at offset 68; census method). >0 means the table bytes are self-contained in the .fxp.

script.description: Wavetable script name when the osc uses a .wtscript (raw sidecar).

res.description: [[relative path under resources/data/wavetables, sha256], ...] for files whose stem matches the display name (engine wt_list names are file stems: SurgeStorage refreshPatchOrWTListAddDir). Empty/absent when unresolvable: embedded tables and unresolvable names keep the loader's own fallback behavior (default table), which is recorded here as absence of res, not guessed.

k.description: Event kind. *_diff kinds (osc/fx type) are NOT known migrations; they mark an unexplained raw-vs-normalized difference for investigation.

n.description: Normalized value/pair (current id space) from the live engine.

note.description: Citation of the pinned-source migration gate that explains the difference.

raw_meaning_pre15.description: For filter_remap: raw ids < rev15 are fut_14 ids (FilterConfiguration.h), NOT current fut_ ids.

rules: Floats rounded to 6 decimal places; int-valued params exported as ints.
Engine arrays iterated in fixed order; getAllModRoutings() sorts routes by (source,destination) in the binding.

Declared reset policy: before each load the exporter resets volume, fx_bypass, character and polylimit to engine defaults, because load_xml does not stream these from (all or old) presets; exported graph is therefore independent of load order and reproducible on a fresh engine.
No timestamps, wall-clock, or machine paths inside per-preset lines.
Same corpus bytes + same engine pin => byte-identical graphs.jsonl (verified by re-run + cmp).

excluded_fields_note: Envelope (ADSR) values, MSEG/Formula curve contents, step-sequencer grids, and FX-param display names are not part of schema rev 1.0.0. MSEG/Formula LFO records carry gap='modulator_contents_not_exposed_by_surgepy'. This is an explicit scope decision for SXT-011 (graph topology + routing + assets), not an extraction failure; revisit before SXT-012/SXT-015 if renders need them.

raw_field_provenance.never_used_for: producing or replacing any normalized value
raw_field_provenance.int_encoding: Only XML tags whose 'type' attribute is 0 (vt_int) or 1 (vt_bool) with an integer literal value are read (save_xml writes valtypes per Parameter.h: vt_int=0, vt_bool=1, vt_float=2).
